synopsis: The Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC covers machinery essential requirements, with conformity assessment and harmonised standards listed as its testing and conformity provisions [f2745, f2746]. It applies to machinery placed on the market until 19 January 2027; Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 replaces it from 20 January 2027 [f2199, f2744, f15460, f15063]. The heavy off-road automatic-braking prototype therefore arrives under the new Regulation rather than the Directive [f7754]. The EN adoption of ISO 18497-2 includes an Annex ZA linking to the Directive, while in 2026 the Commission was still preparing the new Regulation’s harmonised-standards list and intended to carry over most Directive-cited standards; that intention does not establish completed carry-over [f1397, f2208].
